description: Address generator that multiplies a running step count and takes the remainder, giving sequences that skip through the address space

params.text: Sets the address space the step number is spread over, 2 to 32; use 16 to address TD4
Sets the number the step count is taken modulo, 2 to 32, which is also the length before the sequence repeats
Sets what the step count is multiplied by, 1 to 32
Adds to the step number after the multiplication, 0 to 31

inputs.text: Each rising edge advances the step count
A rising edge sets the step count to zero and blocks the clock for 1ms
Sets the multiplier, 3.2 per volt over 0-10V, and overrides the Mult knob while patched
Sets the modulo, 3.2 per volt over 0-10V, and overrides the Mod knob while patched
Sets the offset, 1.6 steps per volt over 0-10V, and overrides the Ofs knob while patched

outputs.text: The step number as a voltage, the address space spread over 0-10V

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
